line: Crowley gives Yesod the number 9 and the Moon; Jung numbers it the ninth and middle Sefira of the lowest triad.

sections.title: Jung's ninth Sefira
sections.line: Jung numbers Yesod, which he spells Jezoth, the ninth and middle Sefira, and places it in the genital region of the Original Man, whose head is Kether.

quotes.quote: is the ninth and middle Sefira in the lowest triad of the Cabalistic tree
signifies the genital region of the Original Man, whose head is Kether

sections.title: The Moon of Yesod
sections.line: Crowley gives Yesod the Moon and calls the Moon of Yesod the foundation of the Tree.

quotes.quote: the moon of Yesod, the foundation of the Tree
It is also the number of the Moon,
It is ruled by the Moon and Yesod.

sections.title: The Nines
sections.line: The Nine cards are attributed to Yesod, which Crowley calls the seat of the great crystallization of energy, and the direct ray from Tiphareth saves it.

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Yesod.
What saves Yesod is the direct ray from Tiphareth;
The number Nine, Yesod, brings back the Energy to the central pillar of the Tree of Life.

sections.title: The two sides Yesod unites
sections.line: Jung says Yesod unites Nezach on the right with Hod on the left.

quotes.quote: Yesod unites the emanation of the right, masculine side (Nezach, life-force) with the left, feminine side (Hod, beauty)
